eps.d: At the Holby Docks, a drum of toxic gas falls on two dockers - one dies and the other suffers a badly burnt leg. Other workers are also poisoned and the team try to identify the substance. Duffy advises a young girl, Sophie, to drink milk after drinking car fluid from her fathers garage.

Clive King has to try and find out why two step sisters are unhappy after one of them is badly injured. As the story unfolds, it becomes clear that the injured sister felt unloved by her stepfather and Clive tries to make him aware of the problem. A spot check by the DHSS sends ripples through the department and Ewart upsets his wife by cancelling a dinner engagement.
Fleet Street is on the hunt for a life-and-death drama story, and when Harry Homer lands on Casualty the repercussions are horrendous.

eps.t: A Drop of the Hard Stuff

eps.d: A schoolgirl prank backfires, and a young boy finds that easy money has its price.
A cargo ship's exhausted captain and first officer push themselves too far and regret their actions, a joyride goes wrong, and Duffy has a secret to tell Charlie.
It's Rob's last day and he has a surprise patient, but it looks like the end of the road for Holby when a riot ends up in casualty.

eps.d: Rita fights for a soldier, Robyn sees that even good deeds have consequences and Lofty confronts his fears. It's inspection day, what could possibly go wrong?
A high-profile criminal tests everyone's professionalism. Connie helps a desperate mother realise that sometimes acceptance has to come in place of justice.
Lofty and Dylan bond (sort of) over a patient with a big secret. Connie helps a teenage girl accept that she needs help.
Dixie convinces a father to not give up on himself. Connie finds a friend in a patient.
Lily convinces a wife to be honest with her husband, and Rita helps a man change his attitude.
Lily is involved in an accident that could jeopardise her career, and a couple risk losing their baby.
After a difficult shift, Zoe reflects on her decisions and wonders, if she had a second chance, what she would do differently.
Connie continues to fight for her friend who has MND. A man tries to protect himself from his past, while a young woman brings trouble with her dangerous lie.
Connie helps a confused young mum realise what she really wants, and Ethan gives advice to a vengeful bullied schoolboy.
Connie's heroic day comes to an unexpected end, while Cal gets a blast from the not-so-distant past.
Connie needs to prove her innocence in the Alfred case, Robyn helps two star-crossed lovers and Lofty teaches a patient to have more self-worth.
Connie's trial begins. Rita helps a young girl get bittersweet justice. Big Mac encourages a mother and daughter to seek support.
Charlie and Connie embark on a mission to save Louis which takes them to the darkest corners of Bucharest and pushes them to their limits.
Lily helps a mother and daughter escape a difficult situation. Charlie struggles with what happened in Romania.
Cal and Ethan help a son come to terms with the seriousness of his mother's illness, while Zoe and Dylan unite a family.
Dylan and Zoe get to the bottom of how a team-building exercise went so wrong, and Louis sticks up for a lost teenage girl, bringing him to Charlie in unfavourable circumstances.
Dixie helps a grieving mother to let go, and Cal and a leukaemia patient work together to raise money for charity.
Dylan has another bad day, Charlie tirelessly tries to help Louis through his withdrawal, and Cal convinces a mum to come clean to her daughter.
A mother sacrifices her life for her daughter. Through a patient, Dylan learns the power of belief.
Ethan falls for a woman, but she brings nothing but trouble.
An unlikely hero leads the team to a crucial diagnosis, and Rita helps a desperate man realise he needs help.
It's Jacob's first day, and he is already proving his powers of persuasion when a lie nearly costs a girl her life.
Charlie helps a cowardly dad do the right thing for his daughter, and thanks to Max, a son decides to respect his dad's decision.
Dylan is shaken up by an unwanted patient, and Jacob shows his romantic side.
Jacob unveils the truth about a patient, but is it too late? Tess has to make a difficult decision.
The team help a daughter and father at a difficult time, and Ethan convinces a man to come clean to his girlfriend.
t's Max and Zoe's wedding day, and someone's got cold feet.
It's a blast from the past as more than one of the hospital staff fight for their lives. Jacob institutes emergency protocol after gang violence takes a deadly turn.
Tensions rise as events spiral out of control and gang crime threatens to spill in to the hospital corridors.
It's a big day for Louise as an unusual romance flourishes at Holby ED.
There's a new doctor in the ED as life and death hang in the balance.
Terror comes to Holby. Extremists from both sides of the divide enter the emergency department, but it's the innocent that get caught in the crossfire.
. Iain and Dixie are pushed to the limit, but their rewards are many.
Cal's back on an even keel. Can things only get better?
Love conquers all for one young couple, while Charlie helps a father and daughter deal with their grief.
Connie tries not to bring her personal life into work but accidentally dismisses Jacob at the same time.
Not everyone is feeling merry as Christmas Eve approaches.
Cal struggles with his recent discovery and goes well and truly off the rails. Ethan is furious with him as Charlie grows more and more concerned.
Dixie feels bittersweet after stepping up and becoming a hero.
The team have to pull together in difficult circumstances.
Jacob teaches a man off the street how to approach his crush. Ethan is disillusioned.
Dixie helps a man face up to the truth, but she's unsure about a decision in her own life.
Ethan's world is about to be shaken, just as he is getting back into the swing of things. He and Lily work well together helping a autistic girl get the support she needs.
Not everyone is feeling the love on Valentine's Day.

Grace suffers from a panic attack. Sam convinces Connie that she isn't a good mother, but Jacob sees that she doesn't want Grace to leave again. Grace sets off to catch her flight, with Connie hoping to reach her in time. Noel discovers the truth and moves out of Big Mac's. Mercedes finds herself forced to sell drugs and ends up in hospital. Zoe and Max sleep together.

Lofty is asked to run the nursing team for a day and struggles with the pressure of his new position. He steps up and asks a disruptive patient to leave, but this soon backfires when the patient is brought back in as an emergency case. They soon manage to save her, but another silly mistake causes a agency nurse to receive a shock from a defibrillator.

Lofty has to decide what to say in his statement in the aftermath of the Diana incident. Dylan tells him to be clear it was an accident. Will Lofty decide to confess everything to Rita, or will he carry the burden forever?
Lofty has a life-changing decision to make when he comes face to face with the consequences of his actions.

On a terrifying day, Connie realises how much Jacob means to her as he puts himself in danger to save her. She's ready to say ‘yes' to love, but is reluctant to tell Grace about their relationship. Before she gets a chance to break the news, Grace catches them kissing and is furious, giving her mother an ultimatum. Mercedes comes in with her son Connor.

After a terrifying day, Connie gets some perspective when she's faced with the prospect of never seeing Grace again. Connie tells Jacob that they can't be together as she has to focus on Grace. Distancing himself from her, Jacob spends a day out with the paramedics and ends up in a partly-collapsed building. When Connie hears Jacob is in trouble, she races to the scene to help.

Jacob has reverted to being an alpha male and takes it upon himself to track down a dangerous drug dealer in Holby. With several patients suffering from the same symptoms, he skilfully persuades an unlikely person to comply. Big Mac is more reliant on his painkillers than ever. He tries to get Zoe to write him another prescription, but to no avail.

Big Mac's secret is getting on top of him and he's not the only one who's reached their limit today. Painkillers are reported missing and suspected stolen. Big Mac's addiction is starting to affect his health. Mercedes threatens him to steal more drugs, but Big Mac eventually has to come clean to Noel and admit he has a problem.
A new doctor starts at the emergency department and she's about to get a baptism of fire.
Dylan gets a nasty surprise when a familiar face arrives in the emergency department asking for forgiveness. But is it all too little too late?
Robyn is determined to bring David out of his shell, and Big Mac struggles to hide the toll his addiction is taking.

eps.t: The Best Day of My Life

eps.d: In a special 1,000th episode of Casualty, an old friend pops down from the obstetrics and gynaecology department and reveals to Charlie that they are back working as an agency nurse in Holby.

Connie agrees to offer a nervous Jacob moral support at a presentation. Rita turns up to work with a black eye, and when Ian assumes it was Mark's doing, she doesn't deny it. Back at the ED, a herion addict dies.
Medical drama. Dylan treats his family, while David uncovers Glen's secret.
Rita gets a frosty reception from the ED, while Iain struggles to assert his authority.
Connie deals with a case too close to home; will she and Grace find a way through?
Feature-length episode of the medical drama. As Charlie celebrates his thirtieth anniversary, the department is thrown into chaos, and the team face their biggest challenge yet.
Elle attempts to rally the troops, and Alicia discovers an uncomfortable truth.

Jac Naylor comes down to the Emergency Department to perform an emergency operation and Iain finds his injuries affecting his work. Lily suspects he's not well and persuades him to be re-examined. She helps him see that he doesn't have to be Mr Action Man all the time, and a strange friendship is born between them. Robyn is wracking her brain to think of something special to do for Glen.
Ethan and Alicia are thrown together in a rescue operation, while Louise is on a mission to improve the relatives' room.
Charlie's high school sweetheart stands in the way of Duffy, whilst David is forced to reveal some inner truths.
Ethan struggles to make Alicia's birthday a day to remember, and Lily deals with a family feud too close to home.

eps.t: Too Much Love Will Kill You
eps.d: Robyn's plans are thwarted when Glen takes a turn for the worse, and Dylan's clinical skills are put to the test.
Elle questions Connie's focus, while Robyn's plans for the future take an unexpected turn.
Robyn faces a difficult decision, while Ethan passes up the chance of happiness for the sake of his brother.
Dervla goes missing, and Dylan is distraught. Could the new F1 have something to do with it?

Dylan is still wary of his new mentee, Sebastian, but when Seb's father Mr. Grayling comes downstairs as a surgical consult, it becomes clear that Seb is terrified of disappointing his strict father, and Dylan begins to sympathise with Seb.
An undercover inspection pits the doctors against the nurses, as Connie struggles to come to terms with Grace's condition.
After a disappointing review, Jacob, Charlie and Duffy decide to challenge the team. Will Louise find her heart? Can Noel compete with the brainless machines? Does David have the courage he needs?

eps.t: All I Want for Christmas is You
eps.d: Ethan is struggling to bury his feelings for Alicia, made worse by hearing Cal and Alicia giggling together in the room next door. Ethan tries to take his mind off her by inviting another girl to the Christmas party but he can't take his eyes off Alicia. Will Ethan finally confess his feelings for her?
Duffy is forced to choose between her own happiness and that of her family, while Dylan and Seb struggle to work together following an awkward Christmas party.

eps.t: New Year, New Me, New You
eps.d: Rumours spread about Seb and Dylan, while Ethan's loyalty is pushed to the limit.

Dylan wakes up to the wreck of his houseboat he made in rage the previous night after Seb's allegation. With Max and Jez determined to help him after it becomes the gossip of the ED, they try to record Seb confessing his guilt, but to no avail. Will Seb ruin Dylan's career or will he retract his allegations? Ethan and Alicia wake up together in blissful happiness.
Elle's career is on the line as Connie goes on the warpath, while David struggles to connect with his son.
Iain is confronted by his secret past, and Connie continues her crusade against Elle.
Cal's trust in Alicia is tested by a horrifying discovery, and Charlie and Duffy's wedding is in jeopardy.

eps.t: The Stag, the Dog and the Sheep
eps.d: Charlie is missing following his stag do, and Duffy is convinced he has cold feet.
Connie's crusade reaches its pinnacle at Elle's hearing. Robyn questions whether she is fit to be a mother.
Iain tries to make amends for his past but gets more than he bargained for. Dylan struggles to cope in an ED under pressure of binge drinkers.
Connie's faced with a difficult decision when an opportunity for vengeance arises. Iain's determined to make amends with his sister.
David's erratic behaviour is cause for concern, and Gem struggles on her first day at work.
Charlie helps a reluctant friend to face her fears as David's behaviour spirals out of control.
Robyn tries to make David see sense as the team rush to find them, but an unexpected arrival makes her own situation all the more perilous.
Five days spent with Robyn on the neonatal intensive care unit - will her baby pull through the traumas of her premature birth?
There's bad news in store for the team as Sam announces budget cuts. And Gem hitches a ride with Iain.
Connie is faced with a tough decision when Hugo's dad delivers some shocking news. David faces a difficult first day back after his breakdown.
Jez's promiscuity lands him in hot water, as Cal rallies the team to take on Sam.
Sam goes back to the floor and makes an error, while Iain's disappointment in his sister leads to tragic consequences.
Events with the Ellissons spiral out of control, while Gemma faces the consequences of her actions.
Jez reveals his true feelings for Mickey, as a revelation about recent events leaves Ethan reeling.
It is time for Hugo to go home, but is Connie ready to let him go?
Elle's career talk at her son Blake's school doesn't go to plan when she discovers some unexpected truths about him and his friends. Luckily Jacob and Josh are on hand to help.
When Ethan comes face to face with Scott Ellisson, will he get the answers he wants?

eps.t: Do Not Stand at My Grave and Weep
eps.d: Ethan looks for answers about Cal's last moments as he plans his last goodbye.
It is the day of the consultants' interviews, but who is going to lose their job? Lily and Iain are loved up after a night of passion, but how long will it last?
A new registrar arrives for his first shift, sending shockwaves through the ED. David enlists a reluctant Dylan to help turn his fortunes around.
Ethan's obsession with Scott Ellisson comes between his relationship with Alicia, while Connie and Sam's feud puts the team in an awkward position.
Jez and Mickey's relationship is put to the test, while the team rally to raise money for the Calais trip.
The Ellissons are back in the ED creating trouble, while Connie shows off a fixed Grace.
Ethan throws himself into work. Jez faces a harrowing incident. Duffy mentors a pair of school girls who are observing an hour in the department.
As some of the team head to France to help aid efforts at a refugee camp, their experiences leave lasting impressions. At the ED, Connie's world is rocked by sudden news.
Conditions at the refugee camp cause a member of the ED team to take drastic action. In Holby, recent events are taking their toll on Jez.
Ethan struggles to put the past behind him, while Iain meets Lily's family, and Dylan's moral compass gets him in a tight spot.
Dylan's plan to reunite Sanosi with his uncle doesn't turn out the way he would have hoped, and Alicia begins her driving lessons with Elle, giving her a crash course.
A familiar face returns under a different guise, while Elle questions how happy she is being a single mother.
An anxious Connie focuses on Ethan's consultancy revision while waiting for the results of her tests. Elle meets a potential love interest.
Connie struggles to deal with the results of her scans and what it means for her future. Dylan is forced to bring Sanosi into the ED.
Dylan's secret starts to unravel around him as more people get drawn in. Lily's jealousy of Sam threatens her budding relationship with Iain.
A near miss with the discovery of Sanosi leaves Dylan at breaking point. David desperately tried to stop his friend making a terrible mistake.
A new face joins the ED team, while Lily has to make a choice between career and love.
Ethan wrestles with his guilt, while Connie makes a drastic decision over her treatment.
A flashback to the secret story of Dylan and his surprise journey with Robyn's ex-fiance Glen.

Ethan takes Connie for her first day of chemotherapy. Not wanting to show nerves or weakness, she bats Ethan away by putting him in charge of the ED. To Robyn's horror, Glen gets a job as a porter in the ED.

Connie's illness starts to noticeably affect her work, but she continues to brush away Charlie's support. Max, growing tired of his lack of love life, is given hope when attractive new coffee shop worker Polly catches his eye. Ethan takes his practical consultancy exams.
Elle has a shock in store for Jacob. Rash questions his future as a doctor after treating an old girlfriend.
Connie struggles to keep her secret when going the extra mile for a patient leaves her in terrible danger.
Connie takes matters into her own hands, while Dylan struggles to keep things together at the helm of the ED.
Max is confronted with his estranged wife Zoe, whilst he sees in an old friend what he could have had. Jacob needs to step up after his son Blake arrives in the ED with an injury.
Elle's son turns up in the ED with his injured friend after going missing all night, schoolteacher Justine faces the consequences of her decision, and Ethan goes for his interview.
Dylan's alcoholism spirals out of control while he deals with a stabbing and the victim's young boy. Connie befriends cancer patient Maggie, and Ethan is now in charge of the ED!
Alicia takes matters into her own hands when queuing ambulances put patients in danger, while new F1 Bea gets a rude awakening on her first day.
On the day of her son's trial, Elle finds herself looking after the boy he assaulted. Are his new injuries related? Bea's one-night stand leads her to find out Rash's secret.
Under-pressure Ethan makes a decision that exposes the weaknesses of the ED and gives ammunition to the anonymous blogger. It is Gem's first day as a porter.
The pressures of clinical lead cause Ethan to lose his way as a doctor.
Dylan struggles to keep his alcoholism a secret from his colleagues. Bea pushes herself to greater heights to impress Ethan.
Pressure on Ethan intensifies as he has a day to track down the blog author or it's his neck on the line - is Alicia on the cusp of being outed? Rash must face his fear.
Rash's new-found confidence is tested by a prisoner, who also leads Gem into danger. Bea goes up against confident F1 Eddie for a coveted training course.
Tragedy strikes on the day of Robyn and Glen's wedding.
Glen faces a heartbreaking decision on what should have been the happiest day of his life.
Ethan's pregnant patient holds a nasty surprise.
Bea's day goes from bad to worse professionally and privately. Will it end sourly? How will Leigh-Anne cope with Ethan's confession?
Ethan is in danger of crossing a line with Leigh-Anne, while Bea makes a heartbreaking decision.
Connie is back, and she has a big idea for the ED - but Charlie is not convinced.
Iain and Sam, neck-deep in water and running out of time, are forced to make a life-changing decision. When Bea's secrets are revealed, she finally has to confront her demons.
Connie unravels a shocking mystery surrounding her friend Maggie, which leads her to question her own health. Bea struggles to regain her confidence on her first day back.
Alicia tries to process the events of her night with Eddie.
Eddie realises Alicia is scared of him.
Connie and Elle are forced to go on the road trip from hell. Bea starts to become concerned for Alicia.
Alicia finally reaches breaking point, only for Ethan to make a shocking confession.
A first day from hell pushes new paramedic Ruby to her limits and beyond. Bea forces Alicia to face a crippling truth.
Bea tries to help Alicia, but will she be able to face up to what happened with Eddie? Ruby tries to build bridges with both her teammates and patients.
Alicia finds herself on a collision course with Bea after deciding not to report her rape. Connie clashes with Elle when she puts a patient in danger while showing off her new trauma theatre.
Eddie is arrested, but will Alicia get the justice she wants?
Iain's mistake with a patient has serious repercussions, putting many lives in danger.
Ciara comes back into Dylan's life, while the fallout from the crash affects the whole department.
After recent traumatic events, how will Alicia cope with returning to work earlier than expected?
Tensions run high on the day of Sam's funeral, as a grieving Iain faces his tribunal hearing.
David and Ciara fight over Dylan - who will he choose? Iain returns to work, trying to make up for Mia's death.

When Ciara comes into the hospital, Dylan faces a personal tragedy. Will he be able to stay on the wagon? Iain secures Base a place in rehab. Blake hears an anecdote about Jacob's mother Omo and becomes determined to find her.

Ruby and Iain are together for a shift, neither keen on the idea, and it gets worse when they find out they've been pranked by kids. A pregnant woman is involved in a car crash, and Duffy confides in an old flame.
Jacob is faced with his past. Will Iain's heroics stop him spiralling out of control?
Zsa Zsa returns to save Dylan, but can even she help him? Rash reels from his break-up with Gem.
It is judgement day for the ED, as the inspectors descend. Dylan has to face Ciara. Louise's management style frustrates the nursing team.
Duffy wakes to find she has made a huge mistake. Is Iain really coping as well as he claims?
Louise takes a chance on a young nurse, and Iain finally reaches out for help.
Dylan and Ciara make their escape. Will they finally get their happily ever after?
It's crunch time for Dylan and Ciara, while Jade and Marty start to get along.
After a hard day, Iain seeks comfort in the wrong place. Duffy makes a shocking diagnosis.
Tension runs high when Bill is admitted to the ED - will Charlie find out about Duffy's affair? Alicia learns to trust her instincts.
Dylan faces a traumatic Christmas in Resus. Noel is delighted to have met his Christmas fundraising goal, but can't quite decide on a charity to give the money to.
Iain gets beaten up, and Marty chooses his career over friendship with Jade.
Alicia saves a baby, and the reality of Duffy's diagnosis starts to sink in.
Alicia gets a coveted fellowship in Manchester. Will she choose Ethan or her career? Meanwhile, Marty's lies come back to bite him.
Iain walks into the firing line to protect his team. Will he be able to talk the gunman down? Meanwhile, Louise kicks up a fuss to save Ernest.
Iain faces time behind bars for attacking Ross. Will anyone believe his version of events? Ethan starts to move on from Alicia, and Louise vows to protect her nurses.
Louise pulls out all the stops to get Ernest his surgery, but will it be enough to save his life? Connie alienates the team just when she needs them the most.
Iain reaches out to someone from his past, but he does not get the response he was hoping for. Meanwhile, Marty and Jade learn to work together.
Marty plays counsellor for a couple having problems with their relationship, and after a busy and fulfilling day, Iain feels that his work with Ruby is done.
A cyber-attack rocks Holby hospital and has a devastating impact across several departments. Meanwhile, Iain's life hangs in the balance.
The aftermath of Iain's attempted suicide ripples its way through the emergency department. Meanwhile, wracked with guilt, Ruby goes out of her way for a patient.
Archie butts heads with charming paediatric locum registrar Will Noble when they meet in the car park. Will reconnects with old friend Ethan and ingratiates himself with the staff.
Charlie snaps under the pressure of keeping Duffy's ill health a secret, and Rash puts aside his dreams of travelling the world to stick by Gem.

Connie comes face to face with her attacker in the ED, and Duffy finally comes clean about her dementia diagnosis. Ruby starts to get uncomfortable when Dani keeps turning up out of the blue, Jan and Ruby discuss Iain's return, and Jade's nursing registration comes through.
Charlie begins to realise how much he has let Duffy down, Rash decides to follow his dream to go travelling, and Elle is offered an interview for a job at another hospital.
Feeling like he is not quite ready to return to work as a paramedic whilst on his road to recovery, Iain takes on a new challenge as a 999 call handler.
Iain goes above and beyond on his first day back as a paramedic, and Duffy starts to doubt whether she should have been so open about her diagnosis.
Will and Archie put aside their differences when Toby is rushed into the ED. Will is torn between Toby's wishes and those of his mother, who wants to try every treatment available.
Elle learns the truth about her new job. Meanwhile, Jacob makes a shocking discovery about his mother, and Ruby continues to hide the truth from Dani and her team.

Iain steps up and offers his support to Jan. Trouble shooter Ciaran arrives in the Emergency Department. With just three months to turn things around, he is determined to shake things up, much to Connie's dismay. Meanwhile, Jacob decides to confront Jet in an effort to fight for his mother's wellbeing.

Ruby finally plucks up the courage to admit her mistakes to the rest of the team, and Iain offers her his support. Ciaran is tested by his colleagues when he is left to run the department on his own for the day, and Jade starts to believe in herself. Meanwhile, Archie and Will bond as they make fun of Ciaran's productivity charts.
Connie continues her downward spiral, while Jacob pulls the wool from his mother's eyes.

Jacob discovers a truth about his past when he finds out his father may still be alive. Meanwhile, Duffy decides that it is time for her to step down as an emergency department nurse, and Connie is furious with Ciaran when she finds out that Duffy has stepped down. Elsewhere, Jade learns of Marty's betrayal.

Jacob makes peace with Omo when he honours her final plea and takes her home from the hospital, where she can pass away peacefully in the comfort of her own bed. Elsewhere, Archie confides in Will that it was Connie who made the mistake with a patient, not her. Later, Adam is rushed to Resus where Will treats him, and Sofie is riddled with guilt.
Iain gets embroiled in a tricky case with a familiar face, while Jade gets more than she bargained for with Marty.

Connie takes the opportunity to prove herself, but it ends in disaster. Duffy proves her worth in the ED but gets caught up in Connie's mistake, and after a tough day, Iain plucks up the courage to talk about how he's feeling and realises just how far he's come.

Reliving the events of the previous day and unable to escape her own guilt, Connie schemes to save herself by planting a seed of doubt in Duffy's mind. Meanwhile, New porter Rosa makes quite the first impression in the emergency department. As she goes beyond the requirements of her role and gets involved with the patients, David thinks she is overstepping the mark.

When David sees that Charlie is struggling to cope, he intervenes and tries to remind Charlie that he is not alone. Meanwhile, Marty's mother is rushed into the emergency department, and he and Jade have to keep up the pretence of being boyfriend and girlfriend in front of his family. Elsewhere, Connie continues to cover her tracks.
Connie is forced to choose between her addiction and her career, Duffy has a hard day and finds herself back in the ED, and Iain takes new emergency care assistant Siobhan under his wing.
Rash returns to the ED and is immediately thrown into dealing with an attack at a market in Holby, while Ethan attends the scene. And David's son Ollie arrives at the ED out of the blue.

Ethan struggles to cope in the aftermath of the incident at the market, and decides to throw himself into his work. When Theo, an old friend from university, arrives at the emergency department with his daughter Effie, who has Cystic Fibrosis, Ethan puts himself on the line to give her a chance.
An accident brings David and Ollie closer together, and Duffy learns how overlooked some care home residents can be.
Archie takes justice into her own hands to support a wronged patient, a friend from Iain's past helps him think about his future, and Rash struggles to cope as pressure mounts.

Hospital drama with the staff of Holby's accident and emergency department. Taking his own advice with reassurance from Ruby and Jan, Iain decides to join the HEMS team. Meanwhile, Rash's career is in jeopardy when he gets blamed for a mistake made by Mason, and Ethan's fascination with Effie deepens.

David and Ollie continue to clash after Ollie's operation, and David is taken aback when he finds out that Ollie has invited Rosa round to keep him company. Meanwhile, Rash decides to fight to stay in Holby, and new paramedic Lev arrives late for work after saving some kittens.

Mason struggles to ask for help in his most difficult week as a junior doctor and Ethan cancels his assessment with Mason when Effie turns up wanting his advice about the clinical trial. David, Ollie and Rosa are all playing happy families, until David is shocked to learn his ex-wife Rosalene is demanding Ollie come back and live with her.

Despite receiving some devastating test results, Duffy continues to offer her support to others, which results in David and Dylan offering her a voluntary position in the emergency department. Meanwhile, Ethan struggles to keep his personal life from distracting him at work, and Archie turns to Will for help.

Archie is shocked when Vincent, the retired school master who was acid attacked by one of his abused ex-students, returns to the emergency department. Elsewhere, Rashid and Mason finally put their differences aside and make peace when they discover that Leena has Menieres disease, and Ethan finds himself under pressure to rig the trial.

Tension increases between Ethan and Rash when Ethan catches Rash making another personal call. A potential argument between the two is interrupted when Micky, who is being returned from x-ray, starts coughing up blood and goes into cardiac arrest. David finds Rosa's letter in his car and, having caught sight of his name and a scribbled love heart, pursues Rosa for answers.
Ethan regrets his actions when Effie's trial goes wrong, Jade faces a dilemma, and Danny's impromptu visit to his childhood home isn't quite the family reunion he hoped for.
During a routine CQC investigation, Robyn is devastated to realise she can't rely on Duffy. Ethan stifles his feelings and turns his back on Effie, and Rash protects Mason from Dylan.
Ruby tells Jan that she no longer wants to work with Lev after she learns about his shady past. Rosa and David put their fake relationship into action, and the terror attack continues to haunt Ethan.
Rash can't stand it when Mason saves the day, Charlie is shocked to learn that Duffy can't look after herself, and Rosa realises her mum has lied to David.

Charlie learns to get by with a little help from his ED family. Rash feels isolated and left behind as Mason flies ever higher. Will and Archie take on a tough patient together, cementing their friendship in the process.
Ruby comes to terms with her pregnant sister's arrival, David and Rosa celebrate a Christmas wedding, and Charlie's Christmas optimism is put to the test.

It's an emotional rollercoaster of a day for Rash as events take their toll on staff and patients alike. Dylan struggles in his role as clinical lead, and Archie is desperate to impress Dylan but instead accepts friendship from Will.

Dylan decides its time to take a stand, both in his personal and professional life. Meanwhile, Ruby finds the courage to take temporary custody of baby Harmony. When she hears the news, Violette agrees to try and get clean, and decides to send Arlo away. Elsewhere, Connie returns to the emergency department.
Jacob attempts to make a difference in two patients' lives, while Ruby helps Archie get to the bottom of an ED mystery.

Faith brings her son Luka to the ED after he falls from his sister's bunk bed, injuring his head and wrist. Dylan treats the youngster, and becomes more concerned that there is an underlying issue, and following a CT scan, he is diagnosed with a brain tumour. A concerned Charlie has to placate a distressed Duffy, who has been trying to phone Bill in the early hours of the morning.

Marty is betrayed by a man he thought he had fallen in love with, and an injured pilot who had been tasered for attempting to hijack a plane is been brought into the emergency department for treatment. Meanwhile, Archie and Connie bond over their work, and Charlie questions his decision to put Duffy in a care home.
An anxious Charlie searches for Duffy, who is missing in hostile weather conditions. Meanwhile, Lev is unable to accept the severity of Luka's prognosis.

Charlie struggles to deal with recent events in the emergency department, and Connie finds it increasingly difficult to hide her emotions, which could bring her and Archie closer together. Meanwhile, Rash finds himself in the middle of an intense and complex case when two friends are brought to the emergency department for treatment.

Ruby and Violette's relationship is pushed to the limit when Violette betrays Ruby's trust... and puts baby Harmony's life in danger. After spending the night with Lara from IT, Will is struggling to finish a tedious report for Connie and ends up calling on Lara for help. But Will soon learns not to mix romance and work.

Violette is trying her best to get clean in rehab, and is prepared to fight Ruby for custody of baby Harmony. However, a bad decision leads to devastating consequences for the sisters… Faith struggles to cope with Luka's diagnosis and considers joining a support group for parents of children with cancer. When Lev is adamant that he doesn't need help, Faith turns to Dylan for comfort.

Faith and Lev prepare for Luka's surgery and the Emergency Department rally around to show their support for the family. Meanwhile, Zsa Zsa, who has flown in for the operation, interrogates Dylan on the lengths he has gone to for Faith. The team is shocked when Charlie returns to work earlier than expected, despite Duffy's death.
Ruby fails to juggle Harmony and work, and Marty pushes Jade to the limit.

A new paramedic joins Lev on a shift and soon catches Will's eye in the emergency department. Meanwhile, Rash nervously stands in for Archie at a conference for junior doctors and learns to trust his own judgement when he is confronted with a bullish patient.
A heartbroken Lev struggles with Luka's chemotherapy, and grieving Charlie finally snaps.
Rash defies Connie while dealing with a complex case, and Ruby makes a life-changing decision.

An excited Fenisha asks Jan about holiday leave, but her good mood is cut short when she discovers she is pregnant. Connie is called upon to treat a drunk Charlie, who's scraped his head falling over in the park. Realising that Charlie's dramatic exit from the ED following Duffy's death was merely the start of his struggles, Connie encourages the department to keep this as quiet as possible, so…

Up to his eyes in work, an overwhelmed Noel is brushed off by Connie, but is quickly distracted by a troubled teenager in the emergency department, who has inured her hand punching a car door, and her mother Sandi. Meanwhile, Dylan does what he can to help an overwhelmed Faith as she struggles to cope while Luka is in chemotherapy, and things become complicated for Fenisha when a patient on a…

Jade makes a huge decision about her reaching out to her birth mother. When marine veteran Nate comes into the hospital claiming to have fallen from his wheelchair during a stunt, he quickly bonds with Jacob, who is thrilled to treat someone with such an exciting life. Meanwhile, Fenisha disobeys Jan's orders when the pair attend the scene of an accident at a wrestling match.

When ex-con Mick realises his son, Connor, is being moved to America, he desperately pulls a gun on his social worker, Ruth. In an attempt to escape, Mick shoots Ruth in the leg, and flees the hospital. Later, he returns and takes hostages in the emergency department, and Charlie puts his life on the line to try and protect those around him.

Jade prepares to meet her birth mother for the first time. She's incredibly nervous, convinced she was given away because of her deafness, but Marty tries his best to reassure her. She faces her fears and heads to a cafe to meet her mum, finally uncovering the truth behind her past in the process.
Lev reflects on a traumatic childhood after connecting with a patient of similar heritage, and Jan struggles to prioritise her marriage over her work.
Ethan battles his PTSD and throws himself into action after a dangerous incident at Holby Comic Con, and Faith leans on Dylan for support after Luka's latest scan.
Jacob is concerned when Nate is brought into the ED struggling to breathe, and temptation gets the better of Lev.
David struggles to manage his bipolar symptoms as his past comes back to haunt him, and Dylan's morals are pushed to their limit.
An utterly conflicted Dylan struggles to contain his fury at Lev, and Fenisha steps up to help in Jan's hour of need.
Jacob betrays Connie's trust, Noel makes a heartbreaking mistake, and opinions in the ED are divided when an illegal stowaway falls from the sky.
Marty reconnects with his homophobic father, and Rash is forced to intervene as disaster strikes the ED and the team are thrown into chaos.
When the coronavirus pandemic hits Holby ED, Connie struggles to protect her team, Will becomes disillusioned with his work and Fenisha rushes to keep her baby safe.

Jacob wants more from Connie, but she is unsure if will she be able to make the time for their relationship with mounting pressures on the emergency department. Meanwhile, Faith confronts Lev about his secret, and new paramedic Leon arrives to meet the rest of the team and complete a Covid-19 training course.

An exhausted Will faces his last day in ED - but will he be able to make peace with his colleagues in the department? Robyn goes the extra mile to help a conflicted patient, while Rash plucks up the courage to get himself a date.

Faith and Dylan are brought closer together, but when Faith is in peril after her ambulance crashes, will Dylan be able to save her in time? Ethan reveals his deepest fears to Rash and realises he must trust his judgement. Leon learns that the ED always has his back
Jacob's life is thrown into peril when a suspected bomber enters the emergency department, and an exhausted Marty struggles to accept his father's attempts at reconciliation.
A harrowing domestic abuse case brings things to a head between Fenisha and Jan, while Lev grapples with the truth that is tearing apart his family.
With Fenisha's life in danger, Ethan must race against time to try to save his family.

Fenisha and Ethan have kept their distance since Fenisha had their baby, but when Bodhi is rushed into hospital, Fenisha realises that Ethan will be there to support her. Meanwhile, Connie is shocked by Grace's behaviour, and Rosa encourages Ollie to make a move.
Can Jan make the ultimate sacrifice to save her son? Faith and Lev do everything they can to keep their marriage together, and Connie interferes in Grace's love life.

Jan's fear is tearing her apart as she desperately tries to keep her son safe. Connie takes out her frustrations on Jacob's new relationship, and a bit of fun accidentally leads Charlie to create a betting ring.
As paranoia eats away at her marriage, will Faith finally give in to temptation with Dylan?
Faith's personal struggles end up putting her daughter in danger. Tina finds herself in Connie's war path.
When Grace takes Ollie's life into her own hands, it threatens to ruin Connie's relationship with her daughter forever.
Dylan realises it's best to move on, and David realises Rosa isn't coping. Can an old friend save Jan from breaking point?
Faith finally cracks as her family unit falls apart, Marty battles with his conscience, and Iain puts himself on the line to protect Jan.
Jade's confidence is crushed when a night out turns to disaster, Fenisha discovers the painful truth about Ethan's diagnosis, and Tina pushes her luck with Jacob.
Jan must decide between honesty or saving her marriage, Leon battles for his job, and Jacob and the team grapple with treating a white supremacist.
Will Lev ever be able to trust his colleagues again?
Jade takes justice into her own hands, and Jan is moved to fight for a worthy cause.
Rash's past is revealed when an old friend arrives in the ED. Iain and Faith bond as they treat a dementia patient and her adoring husband. And Tina reminisces about her grief for Nat.
Marty's family life crashes around him as he confronts a familiar face, and Jacob realises the true extent of his feelings for Tina.
Fenisha's life is thrown into disarray when a familiar face from her past appears. Rash fights to prove his competence, and Marty goes the extra mile to support women's issues.
Lev ruins his chance at happiness, Ethan is forced to consider the future of his family, and Charlie receives an unexpected visitor.
Tina allows her jealousy to get the best of her, Faith attempts to rescue Lev from self-sabotage, and Robyn reconnects with an old friend.
A terrifying accusation throws David and Rosa's family into disarray, and Fenisha discovers the truth about Ethan's feelings for her.
Lev finally admits the truth about his sexuality, Rash glimpses Tina's manipulative side, and Charlie is left reeling when he's accused of breaking up a marriage.
Fenisha makes the ultimate choice to follow her heart, and David is distraught to realise he's destroyed his family.
Jacob struggles to find a safe path as tensions with Tina escalate.
As Fenisha and Ethan prepare for their big day, Matthew battles his emotions, Lev faces up to his sexuality once and for all, and Ollie's mystery illness is finally diagnosed.
Ethan and Fenisha are running late for their big day, and Tina's manipulation of Jacob continues
Ethan is rushed into the ED, and a new face appears in the department, ready to exact revenge on those who have wronged her.
Jacob reaches a turning point in his relationship with Tina. Ethan struggles to balance work, grief and being a single parent, and Teddy uncovers Jan's secret.
A medical crisis brings Jan and Ffion together, and tensions between Matthew and Ethan finally come to a head.
Tensions escalate between Tina and Jacob as outsider Iain gets an insight into their issues, and Jade lets Stevie in on an awful secret.
A surprise reunion and an unexpected betrayal force Jade to question whether the ED is really the place for her.
Matthew's memories of his time in Africa begin to impact his work, while a chance encounter from his past forces Rash into a very difficult situation.
When Tina returns to the ED, Jacob is forced to confront the reality of their relationship. Teddy attempts to welcome a new face into the paramedic family.
A day in the life of Holby's paramedics. Sah, Iain, Jan and Teddy contend with the realities of being on the front line.
Desperate to help, Rash becomes further embroiled in the gang, and the consultants fight over the clinical lead job.
Stevie gains an unlikely friend, Jacob's denial threatens his job, and Robyn gets distracted by Paul's return to the ED.
Stevie's grief fuels her rage towards Ethan, and Rash finds himself and his family in danger.
Jan and Ffion are forced together in a terrifying hostage situation, and Stevie's job hangs in the balance.
Rash's life hangs in the balance when he is kidnapped, and Dylan fights to help a patient who struggled to advocate for herself.
As the team battle to keep the ED supplied with oxygen at Christmas, a troubled patient from the past returns for revenge.
As Iain battles for his life, will Charlie recognise Laura in time?
New doctor Paige makes a dramatic first impression on the ED team, and Faith decides it's time to move on.
Paige is determined to redeem herself on her first ED shift, while Dylan fights for Paula's right to keep her baby.
Stevie fears for her friend when Faith crosses a dangerous line. When Bodhi is taken ill, will Ethan be able to be the father his son needs?
Faith and Stevie come to blows as Faith continues to spiral. Iain is shocked to find himself working with ex-lover Chrissie.
Dylan rushes to Paula's aid when she goes into labour. Robyn makes a life-changing discovery.
Robyn must come to a decision about her unexpected pregnancy, while Paige tries to change her bedside manner.
Faith's world comes crashing down when Luka is targeted by a predator. Teddy encourages Sah to open up.
An impossible medical dilemma reawakens past trauma for Matthew, while Marty worries that his relationship with Adi is moving too fast.
Charlotte's classmate is brought into the ED in a critical condition, while Teddy is visited by his overbearing mum.
Matthew struggles to suppress his past trauma, while Marty's relationship is put to the test.
Iain risks everything to help a patient in a desperate situation, and Paul encourages Robyn to be bold.
Teddy pushes himself to the limit to help a patient in need, while Marty grows suspicious of what Adi is hiding from him.
Stevie resorts to drastic measures when Matthew's symptoms worsen, and Paul faces the consequences of his actions.
Iain jeopardises his relationship with Chrissie when he tries to track down Keidi's sister. Dylan worries he's made the wrong decision by supporting Paula.
Paula fights for custody of Ena in court, and Marty finally discovers Adi's secret.
Teddy prepares to leave Holby, and Faith treats a colleague who could be useful to Stevie.
Matthew grapples with his PTSD, and Marty must come to terms with Adi's decision.
Iain uncovers a dark case on his search to find Elvira, and Ollie is led astray by his classmates.
Old wounds reopen when Ethan lands a date with a police officer.
Sah comes face-to-face with a figure from their past, and David tries to win Ollie back onto his side.
Iain puts his life on the line, and Paige grows closer to Rash.
Paige and Rash try to hide their relationship from the ED, and David fights to save a patient from herself.
Rash struggles to do the right thing for Paige, and Robyn steps up to help Marty and Adi with their surrogacy.

The staff must treat the victims of a school shooting, but the incident proves far more distressing for David when he comes to realise that Ollie may have been one of the gunmen. A patient is brought in whom Paul recognises, which drives him to leave the theatre. As he reflects on his past mistakes, it pushes him to be honest with Robyn.
David struggles to come to terms with his son's actions, and Stevie clashes with a new colleague.
Stevie struggles to control her emotions on Emma's birthday, while Sah has an unwelcome visitor.
On the day of Ollie's funeral, will David be able to forgive his son? – Faith is shocked to discover Natalia has a secret.
David searches for answers when he fears he's the target of an explosion, but is he really ready to know the truth about Ollie?
Rash struggles to give Paige space on the day of her BRCA gene test results, while Sah makes a difficult choice.
Charlie returns from his holidays brimming with optimism, but with the ED backing up, how long will it last? David is not coping as well as he thought

eps.t: We Need to Talk About Ollie
eps.d: David meets a woman from his past who helps him feel like himself again, while Dylan starts fighting for his team.
Robyn starts to have doubts about the surrogacy while Iain and Faith's friendship is tested.
Stevie and Dylan clash, Robyn struggles with IVF side effects and Sah returns to work.
David accidentally exposes his true identity to Susan, while Stevie realises she values her relationship with Marcus more than she thought.
Sah resists Jools's attempt to be there for them and their dad, while Charlie helps Dylan overcome a confidence crisis.
Faith and Iain team up to try to save a family they have seen in the ED before, while Robyn's responsibilities start to take a toll.
Marty sees Adi's true colours, while Stevie is knocked down a peg by an old enemy.
Stevie gets an amazing opportunity, while Paige begins to have doubts about her relationship with Rash.
Stevie's exciting opportunity is jeopardised by a patient, while Jan is seriously affected by her workload.
Faith realises a friend is suffering, while Stevie's mentorship pushes Paige to make a mistake.
The pressure reaches boiling point for Jan in a special improvised episode.
Dylan's clinical lead duties are disrupted by a patient from his past, while Rash worries about Ashok's strange behaviour.
Stevie has a revelation about her relationship with Marcus, Rash realises he doesn't need to deal with Ashok alone, and Paul worries he's not enough for Robyn.
Jan and Sah build bridges, and Dylan expresses concern about a care home.
Jacob throws himself into work, Ethan has a revelation, and Dylan makes a shocking discovery.
Rash realises Ashok is in more trouble than he thought, Stevie struggles, and Paul surprises Robyn.
Jacob's heroics help persuade Marcus change is needed, while Dylan's investigations get him into trouble.
Dylan clashes with an old rival, Robyn and Paul make a life-changing decision, and Stevie seeks comfort from Marcus.
Stevie learns the truth about Marcus, and a patient causes friction between Max and Faith.

Jacob struggles to gain the respect he needs from his department, and feels that Robyn is not putting in the effort she needs to. Stevie is haunted by Marcus' abuse, but Faith helps her to both move forward and see that he suffers some consequences for his crimes. Rash is left struggling with his Dad's welfare after his carer is attacked.
Robyn stands up to Jacob. Marty and David struggle to put patient care first, and Iain and Faith have to work closer than ever.
Charlie questions his loyalties as the ED reaches breaking point, David and Marty make a difficult decision, and Jacob realises his actions might have devastating consequences.
Dylan fights to bring an abuser to justice, Jacob finally faces his guilt, and is there more to Faith's dishonest patient than meets the eye?

Faith treats a patient who has been pulled from the water after a car crash, but her sense of control is tested when an unexpected arrival forces her to confront her darkest secret. She recalls a time when frustration with her own children drove her to lose control, and seeks to make amends by coming to the aid of her patient's distraught daughter.
The paramedics welcome a surprising recruit, and a new face in the ED turns Max's world upside down.
A difficult patient brings back a past Jan would rather forget, and can the new nurses impress Max?
Jan's patience is pushed to the limit, and can Iain persuade a new team member to stick to the rules?
Stevie has a crisis of confidence, and Jan tries to set some boundaries.
Jodie faces her fears, and Faith takes a dangerous risk.
Jodie's night out turns into a nightmare, Faith is given bad news, and an eager Ryan is tormented by Max in the ED.
Faith's resolve is tested to breaking point, and Jacob goes too far.
Iain is forced to face a past trauma as Faith buckles under mounting pressure, whilst Jodie sees a more caring side to Max.
Max causes trouble for Jodie, and Gethin pushes Jan away.
Jan's actions have a disastrous ripple effect, and Jodie lets off some steam.
Faith makes a terrible mistake, and Rida has a mystery to solve.

Rumours of Jodie's apparent affair with Max spiral out of control, forcing her to resign. However, her leaving party ends in disaster when the pub explodes. Donna struggles to keep control of the new nurses and worries she isn't a good enough role model for them, but Rida and Cam prove her wrong.

eps.t: 75 YEARS of the NHS: How to Save a Life
eps.d: A special episode to mark the 75th anniversary of the NHS, where we follow the team on a typical day in the emergency department.
Relentless back to back shifts at the ED bring about disaster for Donna whilst Faith recoils from the one person who could actually help in her recovery.
A lie spirals out of control for an already guilt-ridden Donna.
Max returns to the ED with a secret, and Paige is forced to face her feelings.

Max has discovered that someone has been stealing Diazepam, and proposes new rules to restrict access - a move that threatens to cut off Faith's supply and bring her secrets into the light. When Cam forgets to sign for a patient's morphine, Stevie becomes suspicious that he is behind the missing drugs. Donna's conscience is troubled further when a familiar patient is checked in.
Donna grapples with her guilt, and Jan's loved ones keep a secret from her.
Donna deals with an angry Max after her confession, and Rida comes to Rash's rescue.
Max's health fails him, but he remains in denial, whilst Faith's lies unravel, and Teddy seeks advice from Gethin.
Stevie keeps a close eye on Faith as she implodes, Jodie has an unexpected reunion, much to Max's dismay, and Teddy makes an impulsive decision.
Despite criticism, Jan agrees to help Gethin, Faith watches helplessly as her secrets spill out, and Donna plays a dangerous game at the ED with Max.
Donna has to accept a painful realisation as her sentencing looms, while Stevie tries and fails to help a friend in need.
Jan heads to Switzerland with Gethin, but is she making the right decision?
Taking on more responsibility, Stevie is tested to breaking point. Meanwhile, the truth connects Max and Jodie, and Faith returns to the ED, but not in the way she'd expected.
With his nurses' safety at risk, Charlie vows to help them, Teddy struggles to grieve, and stubborn Max has a painful realisation concerning his future.

Sah begins to doubt an important choice, while helping Jacob treat an injured asylum seeker. Jodie is faced with the reality of her decision to donate a kidney to Max, and Iain offers to support Natalia over her woes with drug addict Faith. Is he making a mistake letting Natalia further into his life?
A fearful Stevie takes decisive action at work, and Dylan overcomes his pride to help an ailing Max.
On her first day back at Holby, Faith struggles with new restrictions, Rash steps up, but is he ready? And Stevie jumps to conclusions, causing her to doubt herself in her new role.
Iain is gutted when Faith draws a line under their relationship, Rida feels guilty about her friendship with Rash being on rocky ground, and Teddy has doubts over his engagement to Paige.
Max pushes himself too far, Stevie makes a fatal decision, and Iain keeps a secret from Faith.
Rash's decision to go to work backfires, Cam's hopes are dashed, and Stevie is faced with a painful reminder of the past.
Stevie's demons catch up with her, Paige's career prospects hang in the balance, and Siobhan is determined to make a change on her first shift as Rash struggles to say goodbye.
Iain goes looking for a missing Natalia. Charlie's fears come true, and Max is presented with an opportunity that conflicts with Jodie's wishes.
Charlie vows to prove there is good in the world – with disastrous consequences. Stevie is proven right, but can it save her job?
As Charlie's life hangs in the balance, can Stevie regain her confidence in time to save him?
In the wake of his dad's death, Rash deludes himself into thinking he's fine. But with mounting pressure at work, how long will it be before he cracks?
Jacob is given a second chance to do the right thing. Rida questions her future after a catastrophic incident rocks her and Rash, and Nicole has to make a shocking admission.
Dylan faces disaster when he doesn't listen to Rash, Teddy's night turns sour after an encounter with a boisterous hen party, and a downbeat Ngozi turns to a colleague for support.
Dylan is haunted by his past mistakes, while Tariq and Rash collide when Tariq ‘plays the hero'. Nicole is forced to come clean about her secret.
A vulnerable Teddy is horrified when he is confronted by an unwelcome visitor, whilst Nicole is determined to prove herself to Stevie. Can Rash learn to take therapy seriously?
Jacob fights for his grandchild, but is he ready to step up? And a still vulnerable Rash forgoes help when he treats a familiar face.
A new exposé about Holby Hospital has shaken the team, whilst Dylan is cracking down on Patrick. The pressure is building on Siobhan, and Cam's doubts are creeping in.
During an explosive shift, Iain discovers Teddy's secret, Dylan and Stevie try to prove that Patrick is a danger to patients, and Jacob questions himself as a grandfather.
Assessment day is here for Rash. Can he get through it? Faith is thrown as an old friend is brought into the ED, and is Ngozi interfering too much with Nicole's surrogacy?
The ripple effect of Teddy's rage affects his career. And Faith's good news is tainted when all eyes are on her and Nicole's friendship is tested.
Concerned for patients, Dylan and Stevie must keep a dangerous Patrick away and Jacob, seeking consistency, makes a drastic decision. Meanwhile, Tariq must choose – family or career?
Rash reaches breaking point, Tariq fights for his cousin, Rida seeks justice by revealing a hard truth, and the ED team band together to save a patient.
As a storm threatens Holby, a tragedy forces Cam to make a tough decision, whilst Stevie makes an unexpected connection and Tariq is determined to help a vulnerable Rash.
Iain dives into the deep end, during a storm that wrecks Holby, leaving Stevie and Siobhan struggling to stay afloat, whilst Dylan wrestles with the prospect of catching feelings.
In the storm's aftermath, Cam is haunted by his past, which finds him at his most vulnerable, whilst Jacob's worry over his son reignites and Nicole is faced with an unimaginable dilemma.
Jacob fights in his search for Blake. A conflicted Cam unearths repressed emotions, and Dylan struggles with devastating news.
Stevie plays a dangerous game with her mystery man, whilst Iain reaches boiling point and crosses a line, and Nicole makes the ultimate sacrifice.
Whilst Dylan is faced with a painful decision, Cam drives himself to isolation, making Siobhan take matters into her own hands.
A desperate Jacob faces another dead end in his search for Blake. Siobhan has a shocking revelation, and Tariq's rogue behaviour causes problems.
Tariq's future hangs in the balance, Stevie's guilt grows as Siobhan falls to pieces, and Jacob is determined to break the cycle for his son.
As Jamie's life hangs in the balance, Cam seeks closure, whilst Nicole and Ngozi share a surprising moment. Jodie admits the truth, but at what cost?
Iain goes to extreme lengths to protect his family, whilst Dylan's indecision backfires, and Siobhan's hopes get raised, then crushed.

eps.t: The Truth Will Set You Free
eps.d: Siobhan's personal and work woes intertwine, reaching boiling point, whilst Nicole's motherhood looms and Cam's fresh start pushes him further into the past.
As the ED goes into lockdown, Cam tries to free himself of the past, whilst Jacob takes matters into his own hands and Dylan makes peace with his feelings.
Jodie's actions causes a disastrous ripple effect, Stevie faces hostility when she puts her personal issues with Siobhan aside, and trainee Indie and Jan collide.
Dylan and Jodie are bonded by a tragic death, whilst Nicole becomes aware that she should seize the day. Can Rash hide a secret from his cousin Tariq?
As Indie faces the ultimate horror on her first paramedic shift, Faith is worried she will lose all that she loves. Will Jodie realise which boundaries she should not cross?
Dylan is under pressure when his actions are scrutinised, whilst Jacob tries setting a good example. Rash is caught in the middle of a blood feud.
Stevie faces a heartbreaking choice between her head and her heart, Nicole's worries overcome her, and Indie is caught out. Will it fuel her to show she's got what it takes?
Nicole hits crisis point, Indie makes a mistake, and Dylan receives some big news.
Dylan fights to prove his innocence, but is time his enemy? Meanwhile, Stevie makes peace with her head and her heart, and can Rash keep family ties from fraying permanently?
In a flashback to her days as a student midwife, Jodie grapples with trauma from her past. But as she navigates her heartache, she seeks closure in the wrong places.
A plane crash at Holby unexpectedly leads to Siobhan and Stevie bonding, Faith is betrayed, and can a hopeful Jacob step up for his family?
Will a vulnerable Faith relapse, and has Stevie blown her chances of becoming clinical lead? Meanwhile, Jodie seeks comfort in all the wrong places.
Jodie must fight to prove her worth when her problems become public, while pressure builds for a grieving Siobhan, and Faith gets cold feet.
A special episode told from the patient's point of view: Flynn fears he could lose everything, Stevie gets life-changing news, and Dylan worries about Ngozi.
Flynn makes enemies by disrupting the status quo, Stevie wrestles with a big decision, and Indie is given a lifeline.
Stevie fears the unknown, Indie has to confront her past, and Rida wonders if the ED is where she truly belongs.
Rida experiences an alarming first shift in surgery, Flynn faces an uphill battle, and Stevie is spooked by a stalker.
Stevie walks into danger as the identity of her stalker is revealed, Ngozi is on edge when her secret is exposed, and Flynn finds a solution to the department's money problems.
Flynn, Teddy and Iain brave a dangerous situation when a violent riot breaks out, Stevie fights for her life, and Rida seeks out the truth – but will she regret asking questions?
Surgery brings fresh dangers for Rida, Indie takes risks, and Flynn endeavours to win over the team.
Stevie faces a devastating shock post-surgery, Ngozi is concerned by her son's behaviour, Indie clashes with Jan, and Rida struggles to report Mr Whitelaw.
Rida exposes instances of misconduct within the ED, Indie dodges distractions, and Rash questions Flynn's leadership.
Rida suffers a traumatic day when Mr Whitelaw's mask begins to slip, Flynn fights to save Anna's life, Rash defends a patient, and Indie helps Iain on a special mission.
Loyalties are tested on the day of Faith and Iain's wedding.
Rida bravely faces her worst nightmare when an ambulance crashes into the ED, Flynn seeks forgiveness, and Stevie is reunited with someone from her past.
Iain's career soars to new heights after a daring crane rescue, but will Faith approve? Flynn struggles with his daughters, and can a tense Ngozi and Nicole still work together?
Patients who have overdosed flood the ED, and Stevie throws herself in at the deep end. Nicole is reunited with somebody from her past, and the fractures widen in the paramedic team.
Ngozi hits a new low, Flynn prepares for a drugs crisis, and Iain and Teddy are put to the test.
Iain and Teddy are exposed to danger from a high-risk patient, while Ngozi battles temptation on a tough shift and Jacob faces a dead end in trying to help his son.
The ED is overwhelmed by an influx of teens, while Siobhan worries about the nurses out at a nightclub. Nicole is compromised, and Faith grows suspicious of the paramedics.
Iain questions those closest to him, Nicole decides to make a difference, whilst Flynn and Dylan clash over how to tackle a drug crisis.
Jacob is furious that he's Iain's number one suspect for the missing morphine, Cam's career is threatened after an accusation is made, and Ngozi worries that she might lose Nicole forever.
Nicole faces a tragedy when her attempts to protect a loved one have devastating consequences, Rash steps up for Sunny, and Iain is determined to prove Jacob's innocence.
Rash is horrified when Sunny's actions result in a brutal attack, Flynn offers to help an emotional Nicole, and Iain struggles to resolve his issues with Faith.
Nicole makes the journey to Newcastle to find out more about her past. Meanwhile, Flynn faces a heartbreaking decision in the ED.
The ED staff have to remain professional as they treat a divisive figure, Iain runs away from his problems, Dylan expresses concern for Flynn, and Ngozi prepares to say goodbye.
In an action-packed box set finale, Iain finds himself on his most frightening HART mission yet. Everything's been leading up to this – but will everyone make it out alive?
It's the hottest day of the year, and the ED's two new resident doctors are put to the test. Dylan is spooked by his past, while Nicole is reminded of Ngozi.
When a school collapses, Kim fights to prove herself, while Dylan digs to discover the truth. Faith receives startling news, and it's time to say goodbye for Nicole.
